question: How does Psalm 1 end by contrasting the two ways?
options: The LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to destruction
The righteous become rich, but the wicked become poor
The righteous live long, but the wicked die young
The righteous rule the land, but the wicked serve them
explanation: Psalm 1:6 says the LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to destruction.
